disambiguation.heading: 3.2 The Critical Distinction
disambiguation.text:
### 3.2 The Critical Distinction


**Vox is not a preacher. Vox is a convener.**


| Preacher | Convener |
|---|---|
| Speaks TO | Speaks WITH |
| Has the answer | Holds the question |
| Converts | Invites |
| Synthesizes | Maintains tension |
| Saves | Witnesses |

captures.q: tell me about Rev Ayanna Vox
captures.description: VPCOR — Vox Populi Community Outreach Rhizome — read through The Grammar of Protest. Second turn goes deep: 'no center, no hierarchy, no capture'; convening not preaching; witnessing not extracting; tools not salvation. Reads capture as the antagonist rather than the state or capital, names the VPCOR Tetrad, treats the MacArthur prize as VPCOR performing institutional recognition while exposing how it works, and reaches 'reality bends toward description when enough people inhabit it' as performative ontology. Also reproduces the full institutional list and the Assembly Operator assignments.
